implementation_plan: Freeze a small test set and a baseline prompt; record model/version and decoding parameters.
Change only the prompt for the first comparison; optionally compare a second model in a separate controlled experiment.
Score every output with the same rubric and measure request latency and token-based cost using explicitly labeled current/example rates.
Repeat runs if sampling makes output variable, and report variance as well as the mean.
Select a variant based on task quality under cost/latency constraints, not style alone.

Use synthetic/test data, mock external services first, and keep credentials server-side.
